title: Cursor Plugin Manifest Schema
description: Local mirror of the upstream Cursor plugin manifest schema for the generated plugins/<name>/.cursor-plugin/plugin.json (Cursor-target counterpart to plugins/<name>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json).
$comment: Mirrored verbatim from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cursor/plugins/main/schemas/plugin.schema.json (fetched and quoted directly, not paraphrased), cross-checked against the real example at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cursor/plugins/main/ralph-loop/.cursor-plugin/plugin.json. Snapshot date: 2026-08-21. No intentional divergence from upstream. Key differences from this repo's OWN codex-plugin.schema.json (a local invention, not an upstream mirror): 'name' uses the real upstream kebab pattern (allows dots, must start/end alphanumeric) rather than codex's simpler ^[a-z0-9-]+$; 'displayName'/'category' are FLAT top-level fields here, not nested under an 'interface' object; 'author' has no 'url' field. This repo's generator (scripts/lib/generate/emit-cursor.js) currently emits only a subset of these fields (name, displayName, version, description, author, homepage, repository, license, keywords, category, skills) — the remaining optional fields (publisher, logo, tags, commands, agents, rules, hooks, mcpServers, variables, minClientVersions) are modeled here for schema fidelity even though nothing in this repo emits them yet.

name.description: Kebab-case identifier. Must match the plugin's directory name and its package.json 'name' (sole version/name authority, mirrors R3).

version.description: Bare string — upstream does not enforce a semver pattern on the plugin's own version field (unlike marketplace pluginEntry.minClientVersions).

minClientVersions.description: Keyed by client id (e.g. "cursor"), values validated against a strict semver regex per upstream.

logo.description: Relative path or absolute URL per upstream; not format-validated here since a relative path is not a valid 'uri'.

skills.description: Glob/path(s) to skill files (directories containing SKILL.md, per docs).

rules.description: Glob/path(s) to rule files (.mdc, per docs).

hooks.description: String path to a hooks config file, or an inline object, per upstream.

mcpServers.description: String path, inline object, or array of string|object — the most flexible component field per upstream.

variables.description: A JSON-Schema-shaped object describing user-configurable plugin variables (type: "object" const, properties, required[]) per upstream. Pass-through/unvalidated by this local schema — this repo's generator never emits it.
